fusions.name: Speck on the Horizon
fusions.desc: Looses a bolt at the first enemy in its path for 28 damage that ignores its resistances, and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Cull the Weakest
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Stoops onto it for 17 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Hawk's Focus
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Spots the Straggler
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
